set.body:
Source: P6 requirement-by-requirement evidence audit and PRD sections 15-20.

Scope:
- Add one fail-fast local gate for shell harness verification, Scala 3.7.4 formatting/tests, and worker packaging.
- Add a v1 evidence matrix mapping every F-01..F-18 and Q-01..Q-10 requirement to live implementation/test evidence.
- Distinguish complete local evidence, optional/deferred scope, and external evidence still required.
- Document exact remaining release blockers without treating Mote closure or a green local gate as proof.

Acceptance:
- The gate runs from a clean shell with writable configurable caches and no external Slurm requirement.
- Every catalog requirement appears exactly once in the evidence matrix.
- The matrix records actual test count and current external P5 gaps.
- Mote is clean after the verified slice.
set.title: P6c: Add reproducible v1 local evidence gate
